articles.title: Herbalife to Announce Fourth Quarter and Full-Year 2025 Results on February 18
articles.mainIdea: Herbalife to Announce Fourth Quarter and Full-Year 2025 Results on February 18
articles.summary: Business Wire: Herbalife to Announce Fourth Quarter and Full-Year 2025 Results on February 18. LOS ANGELES, January 05, 2026--Herbalife Ltd. (NYSE: HLF), a premier health and wellness company, community and platform, will release its fourth quarter and full-year 2025 financial results after the close of trading on the NYSE on Wednesday, February 18, 2026. On the same day, at 5:30 p.m. ET (2:30 p.m. PT), Herbalife’s senior management team will host an audio webcast and conference call to discuss its recent financial results. Related tickers mentioned: HLF.
